# Regulatory Compliance Dashboard

## Overview
This dashboard provides compliance officers and risk management teams with a consolidated view of open compliance issues, audit findings, policy attestation progress, and regulatory deadline adherence. It supports proactive risk mitigation and evidence of control effectiveness.

## Key Metrics
- Open Compliance Issues: 19
- Audit Findings Resolved Rate: 83.5%
- Regulatory Deadlines Met: 97.2%

## Insights
- Six high-risk open items require immediate escalation — four relate to transaction monitoring controls.
- Policy attestation completion at 91% is below the 95% target; 124 staff members have outstanding submissions.
- Regulatory deadline performance remains strong at 97.2%, with one missed deadline in Q1 under remediation.
